tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example} Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0036 1. Example 2.3\group generalized-fixed-points

Euclidean space with its standard metric is both a steady Ricci soliton and, with the potential function $f(x)=\frac12|x|^2$, an expanding gradient Ricci soliton. In the latter form it is called the Gaussian soliton. \end{example}
